title: Generating Materials in Godot
body:
Working on generating materials in Godot.

A few very different surfaces are starting to come together.

![Twelve-panel Godot material contact sheet showing procedural cardboard, denim, nylon, stainless steel, rusted iron, brick, ceramic tile, pine wood, marble, terrazzo, carbon fiber, and a mottled rust layer on consistent test shapes.](../media/code-review-simulator-2026-07-17-generating-materials-in-godot/generated-material-closeups.png)
